faqP: Frequently asked questions about Zineps and our platform.
faqA0: Zineps is an AI-driven platform that connects e-commerce with logistics partners. Online stores automate their shipping process, and carriers manage their customers via the Partner Panel. Everything happens within one smart platform.
faqA1: For both e-commerce companies and logistics partners. Online stores use Zineps to reduce shipping costs and automate processes. Partners such as carriers and brokers offer their services through our platform and manage everything centrally.
faqQ2: Do I need to have a shipping contract already?
faqA2: No, that's not necessary. You can connect your own contracts, but also take advantage of favorable rates from our affiliated partners.
faqQ3: Which systems does Zineps integrate with?
faqA3: Zineps integrates seamlessly with Shopify, WooCommerce, Bol.com, Amazon, Exact, Lightspeed and many more. In addition, APIs are available for custom integrations.
faqQ4: What does it cost to use Zineps?
faqA4: Zineps works with a transparent SaaS model and optional costs per shipment. Depending on your user type (online store or partner), we offer flexible packages tailored to your needs.
faqQ5: How quickly can I get started?
faqA5: Within minutes. Connect your shop or register as a partner, and start shipping or offering your logistics services immediately.
